definitions.explanation: Fabric produced by weaving threads together on a loom. Refers to the product itself or the craft of weaving.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{織物|おりもの}。
この{地域|ちいき}は{織物|おりもの}の{産地|さんち}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This region is known as a textile production area.

examples.japanese: {伝統的|でんとうてき}な{織物|おりもの}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{次|つぎ}の{世代|せだい}に{伝|つた}えたい。
examples.english: I want to pass down traditional weaving techniques to the next generation.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers broadly to any woven fabric, but often carries connotations of traditional or artisanal craftsmanship. Japan has many famous regional textiles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絹|きぬ}の{織物|おりもの}: silk textile
- {織物|おりもの}の{産地|さんち}: textile production area
- {織物|おりもの}{工場|こうじょう}: textile factory
- {伝統|でんとう}{織物|おりもの}: traditional textile

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has many renowned regional textiles, such as {西陣織|にしじんおり} from Kyoto and {大島紬|おおしまつむぎ} from Kagoshima, which are used for high-quality kimono fabric.
